items.headline: Rays refuse to go quietly — a 12th-inning walk-off saves their season
items.body: A night after looking cooked, Tampa Bay pulled off a heart-stopper: down to their last outs, the Rays tied it late and then won Game 4 in the 12th inning, 4-3, on a walk-off single. Milwaukee's Cooper Pratt had even homered to put the Brewers ahead in the top of the inning — but it wasn't enough. The Brewers still lead the series 3-1, with Game 5 tonight in Tampa and a first-ever title still within one win.
items.say: Did you catch the World Series last night? The Rays were basically dead and won it in the 12th — Milwaukee's still up 3-1 and can close it out tonight. Wild October.

items.headline: Overtime madness in Brooklyn — Celtics survive the Nets by a point
items.body: One of those 'don't turn it off early' nights: Jayson Tatum poured in 40 as Boston needed overtime to squeeze past Brooklyn 125-124. Michael Porter Jr. went for 27 and 12 for the Nets and nearly stole it at the buzzer. Early-season hoops has been quietly delivering bangers.
items.say: Celtics and Nets went to OT last night and Boston won by a single point — Tatum had 40. The NBA's barely started and the games are already nuts. You going to follow any hoops this year?

links.text: Insane OT finish — Celtics vs. Nets (NBA)

items.headline: Liverpool host Chelsea tonight in the pick of the League Cup
items.body: England's floodlit cup competition hits the fourth round, and the standout is a heavyweight: Liverpool vs. Chelsea at Anfield tonight (4pm ET / 1pm PT). It headlines a week of all-Premier-League ties — Newcastle-Spurs and Arsenal are in the mix too — with a quarterfinal spot on the line in a straight knockout.
items.say: Liverpool and Chelsea play in the League Cup tonight — one game, winner moves on. Those midweek cup nights are always a bit chaotic. You follow the English stuff, or just the big ones?

links.text: Liverpool vs. Chelsea stat pack (Liverpool FC)

items.headline: Counter-Strike's $1.25M Bucharest playoffs are locked and loaded
items.body: PGL Masters Bucharest is down to the business end: the Swiss stage is wrapping up and the single-elimination playoffs begin Thursday, with the grand final Saturday in Romania. The usual giants — Vitality, NAVI, MOUZ, Spirit — are fighting for the eight-team bracket and a $1.25M pot. Win-or-go-home CS2 from here.
items.say: The big Counter-Strike tournament in Bucharest is hitting the knockout rounds — single elimination, over a million on the line. You play any CS, or watch the pro scene?

items.headline: Say what you want — Nickelback are back with a new album Friday
items.body: Love 'em or roll your eyes, they're unavoidable: Nickelback drop 'Everything Under The Sun' on Friday, their 11th album and first new music since 2022. Lead single 'Rattle The Cage' even brings in guitar wizard John 5 (Mötley Crüe, Rob Zombie) for the solo. Chad Kroeger's voice, right on cue.
items.say: New Nickelback album out Friday — their first in a few years. Be honest: secret fan, or are they your designated band to make fun of?

items.headline: A new serial-killer thriller for the dark nights — 'Nocturne' lands Friday
items.body: Perfect timing for the season: Apple TV's 'Nocturne' premieres Friday, a moody crime thriller based on Lars Kepler's bestsellers, starring Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz and Stephen Graham chasing a killer. Two episodes to start, then weekly through Christmas — a proper slow-burn binge.
items.say: There's a new creepy crime thriller on Apple TV Friday — Liev Schreiber hunting a serial killer. Feels like the right time of year for it. You into that dark detective stuff?

items.headline: The spice must flow one more time — 'Dune: Part Three' trailer is here
items.body: Denis Villeneuve's epic reaches its finale: the official trailer for 'Dune: Part Three' is out, picking up years after Paul's rise with Zendaya's Chani at the heart of it. It hits theaters and IMAX December 18 — plenty of time to rewatch the first two and argue about the books.
items.say: The last Dune movie has a trailer out and it looks massive — comes out in December. Are you a Dune person, or did the sandworms lose you?

items.headline: Halloween's on Saturday — cue the costumes, candy and 'Thriller'
items.body: The big spooky night lands on a Saturday this year, which means prime trick-or-treating and party conditions. And no October 31 is complete without the greatest Halloween video ever made — Michael Jackson's 14-minute 'Thriller,' zombie dance and all, still unbeatable more than 40 years on.
items.say: Halloween's Saturday — you doing anything, costume or handing out candy? I still can't get through the month without watching 'Thriller' at least once.
